description: How the inspector column of TmDiagramEditor presents the properties and layers panels (DI2, desktop redesign phase 4). Tabs (the default) renders them as "Properties | Layers" tabs; Stacked is the opt-in legacy column with both panels stacked above each other.

values.name: Tabs
values.description: The properties and layers panels share one column behind "Properties | Layers" tabs. The default.

values.name: Stacked
values.description: Both panels render stacked in one scrollable column (the pre-redesign look), opt-in.
